title.zh: 🔍  链上侦探 |  HyperLabs已将187.5万枚HYPE转至5个OTC买家钱包
title.en: 🔍  链上侦探 |  HyperLabs已将187.5万枚HYPE转至5个OTC买家钱包

current_state.zh: HyperLabs completed unstaking 3.75M HYPE worth roughly $330M and has distributed 1.875M HYPE (50%) to five OTC buyer wallets at 375,000 each, with the tokens going to an undisclosed institutional buyer rather than the open market.
